details.summary: Canadian politician and fourth Secretary-General of the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) 1996-2006
details.life: Was born 26 June 1936 in Ottawa, Canada. He is the son of Wilbur Austin Johnston, farmer and labourer, and Florence Jean Moffat Tucker. On 11 December 1965 he married Heather Bell Maclaren. They have four daughters.
details.editors: Bob Reinalda, Kent J. Kille and Jaci L. Eisenberg
